revisionNote: v3 is a sample-size and label-quality iteration after the v2 validation failed the determinate-specificity gate 13/15 against 0.90 (both misses were reference-label versus judge cue readings). Derivation rules, output schema, and gates are unchanged from v2. All 55 draft cases use fresh worlds; the spent v1 and v2 corpora are permanently excluded. Every draft case was blind-read by an independent second reader (claude-sonnet-5 via the claude-code CLI, 2026-08-21) that saw only case text and the four field definitions, never the reference labels. 54 of 55 cases agreed on all four fields and are frozen here; the sole disagreement (fernery_negative_10, where the reader called a clarification request a productive uptake) was dropped under the pre-stated reconciliation rule. Second-read provenance: config/tutor-stub-boredom-semantic-heldout.v3-blind-read.json.
